PMF.instTopologicalSpace: View each probability law as its tuple of atom masses. The space of laws inherits the topology of the product of one copy of [0,∞] per outcome. A neighborhood basis at p is obtained by restricting the masses of finitely many outcomes to open neighborhoods of their values under p.
PMF.continuous_apply_toReal: For a fixed outcome a, the map sending a probability law p to the real number p(a) is continuous.
PMF.homeomorphStdSimplex: On a finite alphabet A, the space of probability laws is homeomorphic to the standard simplex of nonnegative real vectors summing to one. The homeomorphism records each atom mass.
PMF.homeomorphStdSimplex_apply: The simplex vector associated with p has coordinate p(a), expressed as a real number, at every a.
PMF.homeomorphStdSimplex_symm_apply: The law associated with a point x of the simplex assigns each outcome a its coordinate x(a), viewed as an extended nonnegative number.
PMF.tendsto_iff_forall_toReal_tendsto: Along any filter, a family of laws converges to p if and only if its real atom masses converge to p(a) for every outcome a.
PMF.instCompactSpace: On a finite alphabet, the space of all probability laws is compact in the topology of coordinatewise convergence.
PMF.continuous_bind: For a fixed channel W with finite input alphabet, the output law varies continuously with the input law.
PMF.continuous_map: For a fixed map g from a finite alphabet, the pushforward law under g varies continuously with the input law.
PMF.continuous_channelJoint: For any fixed discrete channel W, the joint input–output law varies continuously with the input law.
